resources.string: Mark’s personal NOVA build · Edition 3.5\n6.4.63-mark.3.5-preview · heretoecode/aos-Video

Edition 3.5 · Startup repair

• Fixed clock cleanup when switching UI modes.
• Added startup, recreation and installed-APK checks.

Included library-page features:
• Centred navigation with Search beside Settings.
• Clock aligned in header; indexing moved to footer.
• Larger Recently played cards first on Home.
• Recently added groups existing and new episodes by show, choosing resume or next unwatched.
• Matching Movies and TV show pages with Continue watching, poster grids, sorting and genre/year filters.
• Compact grouped Network and files cards.
• Settings and classic UI preserved.

Streaming remains paused. HDR badges require verified media information and are not inferred.
